connector.name: Market Data by iturri.ai
connector.registryDescription: Verified market data for AI trading agents: quality-flagged candles, funding, OI, order flow. x402.
connector.summary: Hosted at iturri.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.iturri, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional: 'Bearer <membership token>' from https://iturri.ai/subscribe — covers metered tools. Omit to pay per call via x402.
